extracted.intended_audience: graduate students applying for PHS NRSA fellowship (F31) / institutional grants administrators preparing fellowship applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a PHS Fellowship (NRSA F31) application including the Required Supplemental Form items, a hypothesis-driven Specific Aims page, research strategy, training plan, and institutional/sponsor documentation. Emphasis on training, vertebrate/human subjects compliance, and a detailed calendar of planned activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction (RESUBMISSION)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction (RESUBMISSION)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates presence of a resubmission introduction section when applicable; used to contextualize changes from prior submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship (includes Training*).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe prior research experiences (undergraduate, internships, master's thesis), motivations, and short/long-term career goals. Demonstrate preparedness for proposed training and how the fellowship will help achieve career objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Training Plan Section (attachments list)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Training Plan Section with specific attachments (Specific Aims; Research Strategy; Respective Contributions; Selection of Sponsor and Institution; Training in Responsible Conduct; etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide discrete, labeled documents for each required component (e.g., M-10_M-13 PDFs). The Research Training Plan should detail the research project, training objectives, and how mentorship/institutional resources will support the trainee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims* — concise statement of project aims and overarching hypothesis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State a clear, testable hypothesis and 2–3 integrated aims. Describe the primary objective and the significance of the work. Aims should be measurable, feasible within the award period, and tied to training goals. Include expected impact (e.g., identify therapeutic targets).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Strategy* — detailed experimental approach, preliminary data, and rationale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe background, preliminary data supporting feasibility, experimental design (in vitro and in vivo assays), methods (e.g., osteoclastogenesis assays, microCT, histology), predicted outcomes, and how results will address the hypothesis. Provide timelines and milestones for publication and other deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respective Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Respective Contributions* — documentation of roles/responsibilities of sponsor, co-sponsor, and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify what the sponsor, co-sponsor, and collaborators will contribute to the training and research. Include letters or statements specifying mentorship, resources, and responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Sponsor and Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection of Sponsor and Institution* — justification for choice of mentor(s) and institutional setting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain why the sponsor and institution are well-suited to provide the proposed training, listing relevant seminars, programs (e.g., VPMM, ASPIRE), and institutional resources supporting the trainee's goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (RENEWAL)
rubrics_metrics.description: Progress Report Publication List (RENEWAL) — for renewal applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply a list of publications and progress outcomes when submitting a renewal; demonstrate productivity and progress toward training goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research* (M-9_PHS_Fellow_ResponsibleConductResearch.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned RCR training, coursework, and timeline. Include format (seminars, modules), frequencies, and how it will be completed during the fellowship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements (M-15_PHS_Fellow_Sponsor_CoSponsor_Info.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide signed statements from sponsor(s) describing the mentoring plan, training environment, and commitment of time and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators/Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants (M-16_PHS_Fellow_LettersOfSupport.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include letters that document collaborator contributions, availability of resources, and specific support (e.g., core facilities, technical assistance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training (M-17_PHS_Fellow_Inst_Environment_Commitment.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document institutional programs, seminars, mentorship infrastructure, and evidence of commitment to trainee development (e.g., course offerings, dedicated career development offices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Human Subjects Involved? (Yes/No) and related items (Involvement Indefinite? Clinical Trial? Agency-defined Phase III?).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If human subjects are involved, provide protection plans, consent, inclusion plans, and any clinical trial designations. Note that answers here must match Research & Related Other Project Information form responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Protection of Human Subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe protections, institutional review board (IRB) oversight, consent procedures, risk minimization, and monitoring plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Safety Monitoring Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Data Safety Monitoring Plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For applicable studies (especially clinical trials), include a plan for monitoring participant safety, adverse events, and data integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Women and Minorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address plans for inclusion across sex/gender and racial/ethnic groups or provide justification for exclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Inclusion of Children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether children are included or provide justification/exclusion criteria consistent with policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals Use
rubrics_metrics.description: Are Vertebrate Animals Used? (Yes/No); Vertebrate Animals Use Indefinite?; Euthanasia question and AVMA compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If vertebrate animals are used, provide details in the Vertebrate Animals attachment (M-6). If animals are euthanized, state whether the method is consistent with AVMA guidelines or provide justification for deviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Select Agent Research (item to declare presence/absence).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State whether the project involves select agents and, if so, provide required registration and compliance documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource Sharing Plan (M-12_PHS_Fellow_ResourceSharingPlan.pdf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe plans for sharing data, reagents, protocols, or other resources generated by the research (e.g., deposition to public repositories).

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide procedures to authenticate reagents, cell lines, and other critical resources to ensure reproducibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells
rubrics_metrics.description: Does the proposed project involve human embryonic stem cells? (Yes/No) If yes, list registry numbers or indicate one from registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific cell line registry numbers or state that a registry line will be used; follow agency instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree Sought and Expected Completion Date
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree Sought During Proposed Award and Expected Completion Date (month/year).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify degree type (e.g., PhD) and realistic expected completion date to align training plan and award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field of Training for Current Proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Field of Training for Current Proposal* (e.g., 157 Microbiology).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select the appropriate training field/discipline that matches the proposed research and training activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current or Prior Kirschstein-NRSA Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Current Or Prior Kirschstein-NRSA Support? (Yes/No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, identify level, type, dates, and grant numbers to document prior NRSA support history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications for Concurrent Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications for Concurrent Support? (Yes/No) — describe if yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disclose any pending or awarded concurrent funding that may overlap with the fellowship period and explain arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship/Residency Status
rubrics_metrics.description: Citizenship* — U.S. Citizen, Non-Citizen National, Permanent Resident, Temporary Visa options and anticipated status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate status and, if on temporary visa but expecting permanent status by earliest start date, check the appropriate box.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Sponsoring Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Change of Sponsoring Institution — Name of Former Institution (if applicable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details of prior institution if transferring sponsorship; explain reasons and continuity of training plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Tuition and Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Tuition and Fees*: None Requested or Funds Requested (year-by-year table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request allowable tuition/fees with year-by-year amounts and justification as per FOA/cost policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Stipend/Salary and Supplementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Stipends/Salary During First Year of Proposed Fellowship: Federal Stipend Requested; Supplementation from other sources (amount and source).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State federal stipend request consistent with NRSA stipend levels and disclose any institutional supplementation and its type (sabbatical leave, salary, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Senior Fellowship Institutional Base Salary
rubrics_metrics.description: Senior Fellowship Applicants Only: Present Institutional Base Salary (enter amount, academic period).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide current institutional base salary information as required for senior fellows when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planned Activities and Percent Effort Allocation
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities Planned under this Award — percent effort allocation and calendar-year milestones (e.g., Research 80%; Seminars 10%; Career Development/Mentorship 10%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear calendar of responsibilities and time allocation. Include recurring mentor meetings (e.g., weekly), thesis committee meetings (bi-annually), publication goals, seminars to attend, conferences, mentoring responsibilities, and training modules (e.g., VPMM, ASPIRE). Define concrete milestones per year (e.g., submit first-author publications, complete modules, defend thesis).

rubrics_metrics.name: Training and Professional Development Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: List of seminars, journal clubs, program participation and elective modules (e.g., PMI seminars, VCBB, VPMM, ASPIRE modules, ASPIRE Clinical Laboratory Medicine).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe planned coursework, seminars, clinical observational experiences, module selection, and how these contribute to the trainee's development and translational focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring and Teaching Experience
rubrics_metrics.description: Planned mentoring/teaching activities (mentor undergraduate/graduate students, TA duties, guest lectures to high school students).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Outline specific mentoring and teaching responsibilities and how they will foster development of communication and leadership skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeline and Milestones (Calendar Year / Award Year)
rubrics_metrics.description: Year-by-year calendar describing research, seminars, career development, and specific deliverables (e.g., meeting frequency, manuscripts to submit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a realistic timeline mapping activities to months/years of the award, with measurable outputs (publications, presentations, thesis defense, fellowship interviews).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims — Measurable Experimental Endpoints
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific experimental endpoints and assays listed within Aims (e.g., osteoclastogenesis assays, expression of TLRs and factors that modulate osteoclastogenesis, intracellular signaling activation status, bone resorption assays, microCT analysis, histological osteoclast quantification, pathogen clearance kinetics).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should specify assays and measurable outcomes that directly test the hypothesis and be feasible within the timeframe. Include use of appropriate controls (e.g., WT and gene-deficient mice) and quantifiable readouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Appropriate Models and Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Experimental design using wild-type and immune-deficient mouse strains (e.g., TLR2, TLR9, IL-1R deficient mice), in vitro cultures with and without RANKL, bacterial components, TLR agonists, and recombinant cytokines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Justify choice of genetic models and controls, and describe how they will address mechanistic questions; ensure reproducibility and interpretability of results.
